svg.title: CHUGG: what goes in, what comes out
svg.desc: PlanMotions builds seven inputs, constructs volley::Chugg and calls SolveSequential; the result is a ContinuousState of per-entity trajectories that ResponseFromTrajectories turns into ActionNodes.

g.text: Inputs, the call, the output type and the Motion accessors are from scheduler.cpp (PlanMotions, CollectAndCollapseTrajectoryMotions, BuildActionDagFromMotions). motion_planner itself is not in the snapshots, so everything in the dashed box is from comments and names.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: CHUGG: what goes in, what comes out

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The scheduler decides WHAT happens and in which order (the event DAG). CHUGG decides WHEN and WHERE along the graph, so that bodies never collide: it returns timed trajectories for every entity.
